source_locator: Page for the City and County of Honolulu, contest 'Special Mayoral Vacancy', 137 of 137 precincts
verification_note: Hawaii Office of Elections final summary report for the September 18, 2010 election lists the contest Special Mayoral Vacancy: Peter Carlisle 80553 (38.8%) and Kirk Caldwell 71815 (34.6%), 137 of 137 precincts. Carlisle won with a plurality. The November 2, 2010 general election report for the City and County of Honolulu contains no mayoral contest, so no runoff followed. The city clerk list of mayors shows Hannemann to 2010 and Carlisle 2010 to 2013. The charter text on special elections could not be opened (HTTP 403 from the code library), so the no-runoff conclusion rests on the November report.

verification_note: Final summary report for the November 6, 2012 general election: Kirk Caldwell 157714 (52.9%) and Benjamin J. Cayetano 134740 (45.2%). The August 11, 2012 primary was an earlier round: no candidate had a majority (Cayetano 90956, Caldwell 59963, Carlisle 51101).

source_locator: Contest 'Mayor, City and County of Honolulu'
verification_note: Final summary report for the November 3, 2020 general election: Rick Blangiardi 224474 (58.2%) and Keith Amemiya 149735 (38.8%). The August 8, 2020 primary was an earlier round: Blangiardi 69661 (25.3%), Amemiya 55116, no majority.

Final summary report for the August 10, 2024 primary: Rick Blangiardi 125076 (70.6%) and Choon James 23087 (13.0%), a majority of all votes cast in the contest. Revised Charter of the City and County of Honolulu, Section 13-116 (City Elections), opened as a PDF (page 119 of the charter): city officers are elected at nonpartisan special elections; the first special election is held with the primary; with three or more candidates, a candidate who receives a majority of votes cast in the first special election is deemed elected. The same section sets mayoral elections every fourth year after 1992. The November 5, 2024 general election report for the City and County of Honolulu contains no mayoral contest, which agrees with this rule. The clerk list of mayors shows Blangiardi in office 2021 to 2029.
